caption:
Nobody tells you this. 🧠

Checking your own credit score is a soft inquiry. It does not lower your score.

Hard inquiries come when you apply for credit.

Did you think looking would hurt?
first_comment: Did you avoid checking your score because of this myth? 👇

card.headline: Checking your own score does NOT lower it.
card.sub: It's a soft inquiry. No impact on your score.
